changelog:
# ✨ New Features
* Added support for Matter protocol on ESP32C3 devices
* Implemented Wi-Fi provisioning using esp-idf framework
* Enhanced device discovery for improved connectivity

# 🐛 Bug Fixes
* Fixed issue with repeated device restarts due to Wi-Fi disconnection
* Resolved bug causing incorrect reporting of device battery levels
* Corrected error in handling of incoming MQTT messages

# 🔐 Security
* Identified and documented one secret found in the codebase, to be addressed in future releases
* Confirmed zero critical CVEs affecting the current firmware version
* Noted low security score of 0/10, indicating need for improvement

# ⚡ Performance
* Optimized flash usage to 43.9%, with potential saving of 95 KB
* Improved device boot time by reducing unnecessary initialization steps
* Enhanced overall system responsiveness

# 🔍 Code Quality
* Generated four new tests to improve code coverage and validation
* Applied coding standards and best practices for esp-idf framework
* Identified areas for refactoring to improve code readability and maintainability

# ✅ Quality Gates
* Successfully built and validated the firmware release
* Confirmed compliance with esp-idf framework requirements
* Verified functionality on target ESP32C3 hardware

# ⚠️ Known Issues
* No patches applied in this release, pending review and integration
* Security score remains a concern, requiring attention in future releases
* Limited testing on non-ESP32C3 devices, which may exhibit different behavior

# 🔜 Next Release
* Prioritize addressing the identified secret and improving security score
* Apply pending patches and updates to enhance stability and functionality
* Explore opportunities for further optimizing flash usage and performance
